body.hypothesis: one-sided H0: E[d_t] <= 0, d_t = k * r_D*(t) - r_S*(t), daily, every holdout session

tests.primary: Newey-West t of mean d_t, one-sided 5%
newey_west_lags: floor(4 * (N / 100) ** (2 / 9)), N = holdout sessions at test time
tests.secondary: paired stationary bootstrap of SR(D*) - SR(S*), one-sided p and 90% CI
tests.robust_if: same sign of mean d_t before and after 2022-03-07

body.placebo: calendar lag (Cell 5), k ~ uniform{21..252} sessions per draw. A: D*'s own holdout trade sessions, each carrying the window D*'s ungated sibling selector chose k sessions earlier (never a decision made on or after the session); B: random eligible holdout sessions, same count per (asset, year), carrying those lagged windows. 2000 draws each; statistic = holdout Sharpe; p = (1 + #{placebo >= observed}) / (draws + 1)
